data.explanation: This is an invoice from your car repair shop for a service inspection and new front brakes, totalling €642.30. The letter asks you to pick up the car and pay by 7 December 2026, but it also prints a separate "Zahlungsziel" (payment target) of 10 December 2026 — double-check with the workshop which date actually applies before paying. Pay the amount to the IBAN shown, using the order number as payment reference, or contact the workshop if you dispute any item on the bill.
